decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial care line has had a dedicated page for two years running, which suggests it is a core line for this small cosmetics maker and worth keeping.
The hyaluronic serum is a staple in a popular category and is still listed in 2024, so its low ongoing cost makes keeping it sensible even though it gets only brief mention.
The cleansing oil launched only in 2024 and appears to replace the dropped cleansing milk, so the firm will likely give it more time on the market.
